text: Take a little akshatalu and water in your right hand.
Recite the sankalpam with today's tithi and nakshatram.
Resolve that you do this puja for the Devi's grace, the family's wellbeing, long life and health, on the occasion of Sharannavaratri.
A nine-day puja or a ten-day puja — hold in your mind the sankalpam of the puja you are taking up.
When the sankalpam is done, release the akshatalu and water into the plate.
